jsonData: {"title":"Harbor Weekender","description":"A waxed-canvas duffel that still looks right after a rainy ferry ride. Forty-two liters, bridle-leather handles, and a pocket that fits a sweater without a packing cube. The canvas darkens where the rain hits and lightens again as it dries. We cut it in Portland and stitch the handles so the bag stands up when you set it down.","categories":["Bags"],"price":228,"brands":["Cove Supply"],"uri":"/products/harbor-weekender","materials":"18oz waxed canvas, bridle leather, solid brass hardware","tags":["bag","canvas","weekend","travel","duffel"]}

{"title":"Tide Merino Crew","description":"An 18-micron merino crew that is warm on the bluff and not itchy in a heated car. Knitted in Oregon from extra-fine merino. The shoulder is set in so it sits under a shell without bunching, and the hem stays put when you reach for a bag in the overhead bin. It replaces a fleece for anyone who is tired of pilling.","categories":["Knitwear"],"price":168,"brands":["Cove Supply"],"uri":"/products/tide-merino","materials":"100% 18-micron merino wool","tags":["wool","merino","sweater","knit","crew"]}

{"title":"Camp Enamel Pair","description":"Two speckled 12oz enamel mugs. The only matching set on the floor. Rolled rims, a charcoal speckle, and a size that works for coffee or soup. They stack in the weekender's end pocket. We sell them as a pair because one mug always ends up at someone else's seat.","categories":["Camp"],"price":36,"brands":["Cove Supply"],"uri":"/products/camp-enamel","materials":"Speckled enamel on steel","tags":["camp","mug","enamel","gift","coffee"]}

{"title":"Drift Wool Throw","description":"An undyed wool throw that lives on the couch and earns a place in the trunk. Sixty by eighty inches, whipped edges, no dye. The wool still smells faintly like the mill when it arrives. It is heavy enough to matter on a deck in October and folds into the weekender when the plan changes.","categories":["Home"],"price":186,"brands":["Cove Supply"],"uri":"/products/drift-throw","materials":"Undyed wool, whipped cotton edge","tags":["wool","blanket","throw","home"]}

{"title":"Beacon Brass Lantern","description":"A rechargeable brass lantern. A table light, not a flashlight. Two hundred twenty lumens at the top, a low setting that runs about eight hours, and glass you can actually see through. The brass takes a thumbprint and keeps it. It charges on USB-C and sits flat, so it does not wander across a picnic table.","categories":["Camp"],"price":94,"brands":["Cove Supply"],"uri":"/products/beacon-lantern","materials":"Brass, glass, USB-C rechargeable cell","tags":["camp","light","lantern","brass"]}

{"title":"Salt Linen Shirt","description":"An undyed linen field shirt for the hour when the wind drops and the sun stays. European linen, a real collar, and mother-of-pearl buttons. It wrinkles. That is the point — it looks like you wore it outside. The cut is closer to a work shirt than a camp shirt, with a pocket that holds sunglasses without sagging.","categories":["Apparel"],"price":128,"brands":["Cove Supply"],"uri":"/products/salt-linen","materials":"100% European linen, mother-of-pearl buttons","tags":["linen","shirt","apparel","summer"]}

{"title":"Field Notes Journal","description":"Ninety-six pages of graph paper, a leather cover, and a loop that holds the pencil. Lay-flat binding so a map sketch does not fight the gutter. The leather is vegetable-tanned and unmarked on purpose. A cedar pencil rides in the loop; we include one and sell replacements at the counter.","categories":["Stationery"],"price":42,"brands":["Cove Supply"],"uri":"/products/field-journal","materials":"Vegetable-tanned leather, graph paper, cedar pencil","tags":["journal","gift","leather","stationery"]}

{"title":"Kiln Bottle","description":"A 20oz insulated bottle with a cap you can open with cold hands. Double-wall steel, a powder coat that does not chalk, and a loop that clips to the weekender. It holds heat through a trailhead wait. We tested the cap with gloves on because that is when people actually need water.","categories":["Camp"],"price":48,"brands":["Cove Supply"],"uri":"/products/kiln-bottle","materials":"Double-wall stainless steel, powder coat","tags":["bottle","camp","steel","coffee"]}

{"title":"Weather Shell","description":"A waxed-cotton rain shell that does not sound like a plastic bag. Unlined, raglan shoulders, taped seams, and a waxed cotton that sheds a steady rain. It is not a ski jacket. Rewax it once a season and it darkens in the creases the way a good jacket should. The hood goes over a cap, not a helmet.","categories":["Apparel"],"price":298,"brands":["Cove Supply"],"uri":"/products/weather-shell","materials":"Waxed cotton, taped seams, horn buttons","tags":["rain","jacket","shell","waxed","weather"]}

{"title":"Cedar Shoe Trees","description":"Aromatic cedar, spring-loaded, sold as a pair. For the shoes you mean to keep. Split toe, a spring that does not fight you, and cedar that actually smells like cedar for the first month. They are unfinished on purpose so the wood can take up moisture overnight. One size adjusts across most adult shoes.","categories":["Care"],"price":54,"brands":["Cove Supply"],"uri":"/products/cedar-trees","materials":"Aromatic cedar, steel spring","tags":["care","cedar","shoes","gift"]}

{"title":"Coast Glass 8x25","description":"Compact fog-proof binoculars with enough reach for a far buoy. Eight by twenty-five, roof prism, and a body that fits a jacket pocket without a case the size of a book. Nitrogen-filled so a cold morning on the river does not fog the glass. The strap is leather because nylon saws at a collar.","categories":["Field"],"price":176,"brands":["Cove Supply"],"uri":"/products/coast-glass","materials":"Optical glass, aluminum body, leather strap","tags":["field","binoculars","glass","coast"]}

{"title":"Trail Sock Three-Pack","description":"The thing we reorder most. Cushion where the boot hits, not a club of a sock. A merino blend with a cushioned sole and a plain leg. Three pairs, because one pair of good socks is a theory. They dry overnight on a radiator and do not slump into the shoe by noon.","categories":["Knitwear"],"price":42,"brands":["Cove Supply"],"uri":"/products/trail-socks","materials":"Merino blend, cushioned sole","tags":["wool","socks","merino","gift","trail"]}
